scope: Bind one hash-identified physical AC1018 RASTERVARIABLES frame=0 source record to a locally authored same-version wrapper, then qualify selected ASCII/Binary output under RequireComplete and resolved-owner policies, refusal/retry and typed readback. This does not qualify whole-drawing conversion or native raster behavior.

physicalWitness.provenance: An R2010 DXF authored from scratch with ezdxf 1.4.5 was converted by ODA File Converter 27.1 to AC1018 DWG and returned DXF. The observed conversion lineage is not authenticated by hashes alone. No sample fixture was added to the repository.
physicalWitness.independentPeer: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 reports class 512, RASTERVARIABLES handle 0x2F, a 17-byte body at decoded object-stream offset 2753, inline handle boundary bit 103, class/frame/quality/units 0/0/1/3, role-4 owner [103,119) and reactor [119,135) to physical NOD 0x0A, zero padding [135,136), and verified CRC 0xEADC.
physicalWitness.sourceSpan: The physical-source check verifies the AC1018 inline-object type, RL boundary 103, self handle, empty EED, one reactor, missing-XDictionary flag, canonical 2-bit frame=0, quality/units fields through bit 103, and role-4 owner/reactor fields followed by one zero pad bit. The physical page/frame extraction and CRC path use libdxfrw and are not independent of this repository's reader.

implementation: The AC1018 physical frame=0 selector now applies the same version-specific source-frame verifier as the existing frame=1 route, with the frame-zero 17-byte/RL-103 boundary profile. Captured values seed a local AC1018 wrapper, mapping source NOD owner/reactor 0x0A to wrapper NOD 0x0C. Selected ASCII/Binary output runs with RequireComplete and resolved owners; invalid source fields/graph state preserve the destination, and same-adapter correction/retry produces typed rooted readback.

validation.results: Both physical AC1018 frame=0/frame=1 wrapper selectors passed. All nine focused generated raster-variable CTests passed, including frame controls for AC1018/AC1024/AC1032. Both physical source hashes matched their retained receipts after execution.

limits: The source has unrelated IMAGEDEF owner-role and HEADER suffix observations. The selected wrapper does not qualify or bypass strict whole-file conversion.
The source was locally authored and converted by one ODA version; no producer breadth is established.
No native image rendering, downstream application behavior or general AC1018 support is claimed.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added; the physical witness remains in scratch storage.
